summary: Hard-valid sparse Bybit BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT causal SMT external-liquidity sweep study. Confirmed 5-second swing/equal-high/equal-low pools, one-market raids, paired-market non-raids, sweeper reclaim plus displacement/MSS/FVG reversal and accepted-sweep laggard liquidity-transfer continuation were translated into 3,072 frozen policies with 100ms delayed trade entry, structural stop/target, one global slot and identical 12/18/24bp replay. Zero policy passed development. At 18bp and 24bp zero policy had positive total return; at 12bp 22 were positive, but zero remained positive with at least ten trades. Maximum development trades were 66. Best >=10-trade path lost 1.247619% at 18bp with mean -12.539862bp, PF 0.081586 and -1.331479% after top-10% winner removal. 2024-2026 remained unopened; current cumulative ranking and live permission are unchanged.

trader_explanation.external_liquidity: A rolling five-second swing high/low or confirmed equal-high/equal-low pool becomes usable only after right-side pivot bars complete.
trader_explanation.SMT_divergence: Exactly one of BTCUSDT or ETHUSDT raids corresponding external liquidity while the paired market leaves its own same-side pool untouched.
trader_explanation.reversal_route: The sweeper reclaims the pool, opposite aggressor flow appears, displacement/MSS confirms, and optional causal one-second FVG mitigation permits a reversal entry in the sweeper.
trader_explanation.continuation_route: If the raid is accepted with aligned flow, the paired laggard is entered toward its still-untouched liquidity pool.
trader_explanation.invalidation: Stops and targets are structural; stop-first resolves same-bar ambiguity and unresolved sparse-day paths receive the full stop loss.

decision: Retire this exact SMT sweep-reclaim/FVG reversal and accepted-sweep liquidity-transfer formulation. Do not tune adjacent spans, equal-high tolerances, confirmation windows, flow thresholds, FVG modes or target multiples under the same information dependency. Reopen only with a materially different information source or payoff structure.
